accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:high-smoothness-density-robustness
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The matching root-n lower bound relies on existence inside the declared class of the stated regular QMD constant-contrast path with finite positive information and source derivative.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The root-n upper bound is unconditional under the declared model assumptions; the two-sided minimax equality is asserted only conditional on the explicit class-richness premise.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The preprint defines the smoothed Hilbert-valued SCoDiTE moment, gives its EIF, and presents identity-weighted MMD and covariance-regularized Wald-type SKCD formulations.
The paper develops an empirical HOIF estimator without density-smoothness assumptions for a scalar missing-at-random mean and extends it to the Robins et al. scalar functional class.
The proceedings paper studies conditional distributional treatment effects through kernel conditional mean embeddings and an associated conditional-effect test.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv preprint corroborating the 2024 Annals of Statistics article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper shows ordinary MMD can be nonoptimal in direct two-sample Hellinger separation and gives a spectral-regularized test with a smaller minimax separation boundary and logarithmic-loss adaptation.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: State the uniform-design reduction of rho_n^{occ} explicitly and show how its optimizer compares algebraically with the proved rough lower-bound scale; this makes the proposed arbitrary-density penalty falsifiable before the upper construction is attempted.

Make the lower and upper occupancy calculations share one displayed primitive effective-sample-size quantity, then prove or disprove its equivalence to the current Gamma_n functional under only the density band.

After the occupancy frontier is resolved, promote the spectral question to a two-comparator theorem against named SKCD--MMD and SKCD--Wald filters with a fully specified extremal sequence and a legal causal realization.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with the arbitrary-density occupancy--Gram modulus as the flagship solve target; retain the QMD path qualification only for the high-smoothness matching lower bound.
